subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat convert assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported markup, strip unsupported Markdown to plain text, or keep the current markdown-capable contract and narrow this issue to the typing-name fallback?
rationale: The source-level typing fix is narrow, but the Markdown behavior affects the channel capability contract and prior discussion rejected a strip-only premise as possibly wrong.

options.title: Convert Supported Markup
options.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported markup, strips unsupported markers, and fixes the identity-name typing fallback.

options.title: Plain Text Fallback
options.body: Treat Google Chat as plain text by stripping Markdown and updating metadata, docs, and tests to remove or narrow the markdown-capable contract.

options.title: Typing Fix Only
options.body: Land the identity-name fallback separately and keep Markdown rendering open as a narrower channel-rendering decision.

recommendation.title: Convert Supported Markup
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported markup, strips unsupported markers, and fixes the identity-name typing fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the Google Chat plugin surface and already made the related markdown-capability closure decision.
